name: Space Courier
summary:
Step into a profession from the future and experience life as a courier in space.

In Space Courier, an everyday job takes on a whole new meaning beyond Earth. Cargo still needs to reach its destination, deliveries still depend on someone getting the job done, and that someone is you. Take your place in a future where working among the stars is part of everyday life, and discover the human side of a spacefaring world—one package at a time.
